messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for release v2.3.1 -> initiating 5% canary across us-west + eu-west now. change_window: 2026-03-20T21:00Z-22:00Z

maria: seeing a small alert spike for eu-west right after traffic shift, can you pause? :eyes:

kevin: on it. check which metric? latency or errors?

maria: error_rate 500s doubled on some endpoints, not latency. quick look in traces shows auth token errors for a subset of requests.

ops-bot: [ALERT] eu-west: 500 error_rate increased from 0.12% to 0.9% in last 2m. triggered runbook "canary-eu-500s".

kevin: ok please PAUSE the rollout and pin eu-west to previous stable if we can. @deploy-bot pause traffic for eu-west canary.

deploy-bot: Received command: pause rollout (scope: eu-west). Current global canary remains 5%. Pausing further increases for eu-west.

lia: do we have a quick mitigation? can we revert only routing or need a rollback of model/service?

maria: looks like change in token parsing (v2.3.1) caused auth header handling for older clients. safer to pin eu-west to v2.3.0 while we investigate.

kevin: agree. plan: 1) pin eu-west to v2.3.0 2) route new sessions away from v2.3.1 3) collect traces/headers for failing requests 4) optionally rollback globally if more regions show issues.

sanjay: how do we pin region via CLI?

kevin: use deployctl:```bash
deployctl pin --region eu-west --service inference-api --version v2.3.0 --reason "Canary eu-west 500s spike"
```

lia: should we update release notes / changelog for the pin? ops needs a note for incident record.

maria: i'll add a short entry to the changelog and incident annotation. also tagging customer impact if any.

deploy-bot: Executing pin command: pin applied to eu-west inference-api -> v2.3.0. Routing adjusted, traffic rebalanced within 30s.

ops-bot: [METRIC SNAPSHOT] eu-west post-pin: 500 error_rate reduced to 0.14% within 45s, latency stable.

kevin: nice. good first-order fix. keep rollout paused globally until we validate telemetry for 20m.

maria: can we capture a small sample of failing headers for the next 10 minutes? add to runbook.

sanjay: added: `runbook-capture --window 10m --filters "response_code>=500" --store s3://redwood-debug/eu-west/canary-v2.3.1`

lia: from product side: no major feature regression expected, looks like a parsing edge-case. devs will reproduce w/ captured headers.

kevin: decision: HOLD rollout. Pin in place for eu-west, global canary frozen at 5% but no increases. If no further spikes and capture confirms header mismatch, we can either patch tomorrow or resume with a 1% ramp + close monitoring.

maria: logging the call: pinned eu-west -> v2.3.0, rollout paused. followup owner: @sanjay. incident tag: canary-eu-500s-2026-03-20.

deploy-bot: Noted. Ticket created: INC-2026-317 (canary-eu-500s). Assigned to sanjay.

kevin: thx all. if we see recurrence in other regions, escalate to rollback. otherwise we'll reconvene at +20m for go/no-go. :thumbsup:

maria: +1 monitoring. will post update at +20m with final telemetry snapshot.

sanjay: starting capture now, will push traces to the ticket.

lia: adding a short blurb to release notes: "v2.3.1: minor token parsing fix; canary paused in eu-west due to auth header mismatch; pinned to v2.3.0 in eu-west while diagnostics run."

deploy-bot: Rollout status: paused(eu-west), global canary 5% frozen, pin active eu-west->v2.3.0.

maria: closing the coordination thread, will reopen if status changes. thanks everyone. :heart:
